zh.title: 國防部偵獲共機6架次共艦7艘 國軍飛彈與機艦嚴密監控
zh.summary: 國防部公布，自8月3日上午6時至4日上午6時止，共偵獲共機6架次侵擾西南及東部空域，另有共艦7艘及公務船6艘在台海周邊活動。國軍運用任務機艦及岸置飛彈系統嚴密監控應處。另據本站統計紀錄，前一次於8月2日記錄為共機3架次與共艦8艘。
body: 國防部4日發布共機艦動態指出，統計自8月3日上午6時起至8月4日上午6時止，國軍共偵獲共機6架次侵擾台灣西南及東部空域，同時偵獲共艦7艘及公務船6艘持續在台灣海峽周邊海域活動。
針對中國解放軍機艦的動態，國防部強調，國軍已運用任務機、任務艦以及岸置飛彈系統，進行嚴密監控與應處，確實掌握台海周邊情勢。
依據本站統計紀錄顯示，前一次於8月2日記錄之台海周邊動態中，國軍偵獲共機3架次、共艦8艘以及公務船2艘。

en.title: Taiwan Detects 6 PLA Aircraft and 7 Naval Vessels Near Airspace
en.summary: Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense reported that six Chinese military aircraft, seven naval vessels, and six official ships were detected operating around Taiwan between 6:00 a.m. on August 3 and 6:00 a.m. on August 4, 2026. The Chinese aircraft entered Taiwan's southwestern and eastern airspace. Taiwan's military deployed aircraft, naval vessels, and land-based missile systems to closely monitor and respond to the activities. According to AVWIRE's recorded statistics, the previous report on August 2 recorded three Chinese aircraft, eight naval vessels, and two official ships.
body: Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense announced on August 4 that six Chinese military aircraft, seven naval vessels, and six official ships were detected operating around the Taiwan Strait between 6:00 a.m. on August 3 and 6:00 a.m. on August 4. The detected aircraft entered Taiwan's southwestern and eastern airspace during the 24-hour period.

In response to the maneuvers, the armed forces deployed military aircraft, naval vessels, and shore-based missile systems to closely monitor and respond to the presence of the vessels and aircraft in the surrounding maritime and air domains.
According to AVWIRE's statistics database, the previous recorded activity on August 2 involved three Chinese military aircraft, eight naval vessels, and two official ships operating near Taiwan.
